article.title: Fantasy & Sci-Fi Books: 24 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every fantasy & sci-fi title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 24 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for fantasy & sci-fi books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 24 original fantasy & sci-fi titles written by Jeremy Swain. Epic fantasy, space opera and speculative novels. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full Fantasy & Sci-Fi shelf
body: The shelf includes “The Foxglove Armistice”, “The Ember Cartographer”, “The Night Bakery of Bramblewick”, “What We Fix in Orbit”, “The Face You Borrowed” and “Oathbound to the Drowned King”.
It also includes “War of the Glass Beasts”, “Thistledown and Iron”, “The Ninth Bell of Aurelith”, “The River That Returns the Dead”, “The Salt Road Witches” and “The Last Broadcast Before Morning”.

It also includes “The City That Rented the Sky”, “All My Lives, One Winner”, “The Funeral Fleet of Proxima”, “The Millionth Citizen”, “The Algorithm That Prayed” and “The Last Cartographer of Europa”.

It also includes “The Human Replacement Index”, “A Choir of Dead Satellites”, “The Price of Remembering Mars”, “Emberhall: The Hollow Crown”, “Emberhall: The Drowned Library” and “Emberhall: The First Flame”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The Fantasy & Sci-Fi filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many fantasy & sci-fi books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 24, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
